parties: MPG Family Trust; Bharat Rasayan Limited
headline: MPG Family Trust files SEBI Regulation 10(6) disclosure for acquisition in Bharat Rasayan
sum: MPG Family Trust has disclosed an acquisition in Bharat Rasayan Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 10(6), relying on the exemption for acquisition by persons related to the company.
implication: Regulation 10(6) disclosure signals either a related-party acquisition or a creeping acquisition below the 5% open-market threshold; counsel must verify the exemption basis and whether the trustee holds prior shareholding triggering disclosure obligations under the SAST Regulations.
detail: MPG Family Trust submitted a disclosure to the NSE under SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10(6), reporting an acquisition made in reliance on an exemption. The filing does not specify the acquisition value, shareholding percentage, or the exact nature of the exemption claimed. Regulation 10(6) permits disclosure in lieu of open-market announcement where acquisitions qualify for exemptions (commonly related-party acquisitions or acquisitions by persons who already hold a significant stake and are consolidating). The disclosure was filed on 24 Aug 2026.
